shapes.text: "The human brain accumulates decades of knowledge, experience, and personality — yet all of it vanishes permanently at death, even when vast written, audio, and digital records exist. No system yet ca

shapes.name: Text 8
shapes.text: Billions of human lives end with no AI-accessible record of their intellectual identity, wisdom, or worldview.

shapes.name: Text 12
shapes.text: Existing AI chatbots respond in robotic text — they cannot replicate a person's real voice, breaking the illusion of genuine conversation.

shapes.name: Text 16
shapes.text: Personal diaries, emails, texts, and letters exist in isolated formats. No unified system intelligently queries across all of them.

shapes.name: Text 20
shapes.text: Bereaved families have no way to hear, interact with, or ask questions of a deceased loved one — a deeply human need technology hasn't solved.

shapes.name: Text 24
shapes.text: The wisdom of Einstein, Gandhi, or Lincoln is trapped in static texts with no interactive, conversational, voice-enabled interface.

shapes.name: Text 28
shapes.text: Current LLMs role-playing historical figures hallucinate facts. Chronus grounds every response in real, verified writings — not fabricated content.

shapes.name: Text 4
shapes.text: Goal: The person interacting with Chronus cannot tell they are talking to an AI — the voice, personality, pacing, and response style must be completely indistinguishable from a real human conversation

shapes.name: Text 29

shapes.name: Text 35

shapes.name: Text 1
shapes.text: Security, Ethics & Privacy — Responsible AI Design

shapes.name: Text 7
shapes.text: All data — writings, embeddings, voice samples — stored locally. Zero external AI API calls. Your memories never leave your device.

shapes.name: Text 12
shapes.text: Chronus requires explicit family consent before training on any individual. Models are owner-locked and not transferable without permission.

shapes.name: Text 17
shapes.text: Voice cloning is disabled by default. Requires explicit owner authorisation per session. Cannot be used to impersonate someone without access credentials.

shapes.name: Text 22
shapes.text: Every response is grounded in real retrieved text. If no relevant memory exists, Chronus acknowledges the gap rather than fabricating content.

shapes.name: Text 27
shapes.text: Recognises emotionally sensitive queries (grief, loss, death). Activates compassion-mode responses — no clinical detachment when discussing deeply personal topics.

shapes.name: Text 32
shapes.text: Every trained model and voice sample can be permanently deleted at any time — full right to be forgotten, implemented at the system level, not just in policy.
